CustomField.description: Salesforce formula returning true or false, written like a formula field of the Condition Scope's object (Narrative__c, Product__c or Share_Class__c) and evaluated by DisclaimerLogicalRules (FormulaEvaluatorService). Fields written directly, lookups followed, 4 at most per path: ISPICKVAL(LegalForm__c, "SICAV") or ParentProduct__r.Name on a product, ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "A") or Fund__r.LegalForm__c on a share class, ISPICKVAL(Country__c, "BE") on a narrative. Empty = no condition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula returning true or false, written on the Condition Scope's object with its fields directly: ISPICKVAL(LegalForm__c, "SICAV") for products, ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "A") for share classes (Fund__r. = their product). Picklists: ISPICKVAL() or TEXT(). Empty = no condition.
CustomField.label: Condition
